evidence.excerpt: In this paper, we introduce Composed Gait Retrieval (CoGR), a novel task that retrieves a target gait sequence based on a reference sequence and a natural language modification query.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate ComposeGait on both benchmarks and show that it achieves the best R@1 among the compared methods, reaching 72.38% on Language-Augmented CCPG and 83.61% on Language-Augmented CASIA-B.
